facts: Copyright 2021; PDF metadata 2021-03-16; no product release date inferred
2U1N rackmount; W 447 x H 87 x D 450 mm
12 DDR4 DIMM slots; up to 1.5 TB
Three PCIe Gen3 x8 and four PCIe Gen3 x16 low-profile slots
800 W or 1300 W CRPS options; 1+1 redundancy; no input-voltage claim
IPMI 2.0 and KVM with dedicated LAN

devices.title: Inspur NF5280M5
facts: 2U; without handles W 435 x H 87 x D 779.8 mm; with handles W 478.8 x H 87 x D 811.5 mm
One or two Intel Xeon Scalable processors
Up to 24 DDR4 DIMMs; 2400/2666/2933 MT/s options
Up to two hot-swappable CRPS PSUs. Platinum 550/800/1300/1600/2000 W options; the 1300/1600/2000 W options are limited to 1000 W at rated 110 VAC.
Certain GPU configurations do not support 1+1 redundancy. PSU alternatives depend on the actual module.

Titanium rows repeat 230VAC and list 550 W DC values under higher ratings. Page 36 prints 130W for a 1300 W row and AC -48V. These lines remain uncorrected in archived text; no electrical equivalence inferred.
ASPEED AST2500; IPMI, SOL, KVM over IP and virtual media
Historical platform options, not actual auction-unit contents; no manufacturer or operator attribution.
